module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Partial Fill with Remainder Lot Slicing
precondition: Master opens 3.0 lots across 4 accounts; LP fills 1.5 lots. Math: 1.5 / 4 = 0.375 lots.
expected_result: Remainder allocated according to active policy (e.g. +0.01 to two highest equity accounts); sum == 1.50 lots.
actual_result: Partial fill remainder detected: 0.02 lots. Assigned to priority accounts (+0.01 each). Total = 1.50 lots.
